title: Seamless Save Dialog Fallback & Version 1.0.18 Stability

releases.title: Seamless Save Dialog Fallback & Version 1.0.18 Stability
highlights: Seamless Save Dialog Fallback: Clicking the top-bar Save button when no file is linked yet now automatically opens the system save file picker and links it instantly—eliminating any missing file errors or 404s.
Enhanced Save Resilience: Refined desktop quick-save endpoints to seamlessly fall back to save dialogs when unlinked.

changes.description: Quick-save button now automatically opens the save dialog to pick a location if no file is currently linked.
Eliminated missing file errors and 404 responses during unlinked desktop save actions.

releases.title: Automatic Window Closing & Process Relaunch on Update & Version 1.0.17 Stability
Robust Missing-File Save Dialog Fallback & Version 1.0.16 Stability
Top-Bar Quick Save Button, Auto-Load Save File on Startup & 1.0.15 Stability
Desktop Program (Windows 11 & Linux), Auto-Save on Close, Week Notes & Print to PDF
highlights: Desktop Program & Installer (Windows 11 installer.exe + Linux installer): Installs to C:\BowlingLeagueHelper\ on Windows 11 or ~/BowlingLeagueHelper/ on Linux with a custom Bowling Ball & Pins desktop icon.

Auto-Save on Closing (BowlingLeagueTrackerSave.json): Launches cleanly as a single window and automatically updates BowlingLeagueTrackerSave.json on close—or pauses with a Save / Don't Save prompt if no save file is found.

Week Notes & Print to PDF (Tab 1A): Document tournament details or special league events in Quick Entry Week Notes (saved inside each weekly archive), and export formatted landscape Standing Sheet PDFs directly via Print to PDF.

changes.description: Added Week Notes section in Quick Entry (saved with each Weekly Archive and shown in Season History) plus a dedicated Print to PDF button backed by the landscape Standing Sheet report.
Standardized persistent save files to BowlingLeagueTrackerSave.json with automatic save-on-close protection and a recovery modal when the save file is missing or not yet selected.
In-app updater installs releases directly into your program directory (C:\BowlingLeagueHelper\ on Windows 11), and outdated single-file HTML download buttons were removed from Update & Patch Notes.

releases.title: Zero-Prompt Automatic Self-Updater & Unified BowlingLeagueHelper.html
highlights: True 1-Click "Update and Restart" (Zero File Pickers): Clicking Update and Restart downloads the new release directly into persistent app storage and automatically restarts into the new version—no choosing files or save locations required.
Unified Filename Everywhere: Uses BowlingLeagueHelper.html consistently on GitHub, AI Studio web downloads, and inside the app footer and backup hub.
100% League Data Preserved: Scores, teams, rosters, brackets, dues, and season histories automatically stay intact across every update and restart.

changes.description: Added persistent IndexedDB runtime self-updating so BowlingLeagueHelper.html installs newer GitHub releases and boots directly into the new version on reload with zero save dialogs.
Standardized desktop bundle filename to BowlingLeagueHelper.html across GitHub releases, AI Studio hosting, Tab 5C backups, and app footer downloads.
Kept optional Download BowlingLeagueHelper.html copy action available without interrupting the 1-click Update and Restart experience.

releases.title: Clean "Update and Restart" Button, Version-Free Filename & Remembered File Location
highlights: Clean "Update and Restart" Button: Simplified the update action button to read simply "Update and Restart" with zero version clutter.
Consistent "Bowling League Helper.html" Filename: Removed version numbers from the saved desktop file name so restarting launches the exact same file name cleanly.

Remembered Save Location Across Restarts: Persists your granted file handle in browser IndexedDB so once linked, future updates overwrite "Bowling League Helper.html" in place without prompting for a folder again.

changes.description: Changed the primary updater action label to "Update and Restart" and removed version tags from default saved .html filenames.
Added persistent IndexedDB FileSystemFileHandle storage with readwrite permission reuse so subsequent updates overwrite your existing "Bowling League Helper.html" directly at its launch location.
Normalized default single-file program downloads and saves to "Bowling League Helper.html" across the updater and backup hub.

releases.title: Direct Overwrite & Auto-Restart Updater + GitHub Diagnostics
highlights: Direct HTML File Overwrite & Automatic Restart: Removed the confusing in-memory Update Live App button. Updating now downloads the new build, preserves 100% of your league data, overwrites your opened HTML file, and restarts directly into the new version.
Pre-Filled Active Filename: Automatically detects the exact .html filename you opened so saving overwrites your existing desktop file cleanly instead of creating duplicate copies.
Honest GitHub Update Diagnostics: Clearly reports HTTP 404 (Private repository / missing version.json) or network errors when checking for updates instead of silently showing the old version.

changes.description: Removed the in-memory Update Live App button; updates now require overwriting/saving the actual single-HTML program file and automatically restart the app upon overwrite.
Updater now pre-selects your currently opened HTML filename and uses the GitHub API raw endpoint first to avoid CDN cache lag on newly pushed releases.
Fixed installed version tracking to always reflect the compiled HTML file running in your browser and added clear error messages if GitHub returns 404.

releases.title: Clear Framed Section Borders & Color-Coded Headers Across All 5 Tabs
highlights: Distinct Framed Section Borders Across Every Tab: Upgraded every section container across Tabs 1-5 with crisp 2px borders, elevated frame contrast, and color-tinted header bands so each section stands out at a glance.

Color-Coded Section Headers & Rule Groups: Separated League Rules (Tab 1D), Team Performance & Averages (Tab 2), Brackets & Side Pots (Tab 3), Dues & Prize Fund (Tab 4), and Multi-League & Backups (Tab 5) into individually framed panels.
High-Contrast Dark Sub-Tab Bar: Added a dark slate sub-tab navigation bar at the top of each workspace to clearly anchor sub-sections above the framed content panels.

changes.description: Added 2px structural borders and color-tinted top header bands (Blue, Emerald, Amber, Slate) to every frame across all 5 tabs for instant visual separation.
Split League Rules & Sheet Options (Tab 1D) into 4 individually framed cards with distinct colored headers instead of a single combined box.
Upgraded sub-tab bars and KPI metric cards with distinct borders and surface tints so every frame is easy to distinguish.

releases.title: Natural Instant Undo, Streamlined Non-Duplicated Tabs & Automatic Update Sync
highlights: Natural Undo Placement & Toast Undo Button: Added an instant 'Undo' button right inside the bottom notification banner AND directly above the Currently Entered bowler list and Score Entry form.

Eliminated Duplicate Controls & Legacy Comparison Clutter: Removed the V1/V2 comparison view, consolidated League Officers & Birthdays into the Master Roster tab, and kept all Backup/Download actions cleanly in Tab 5C.
Seamless Single-File Updater: Downloaded .html files now automatically stamp the latest version so a freshly downloaded latest build never falsely asks for an update.

changes.description: Moved Undo Last Action right next to Score Entry and Currently Entered lists, plus added an inline [Undo] button inside toast notifications.
Removed V1 vs V2 comparison clutter from Tab 5 and eliminated duplicate backup/download buttons from Tab 1.
Streamlined single-file updater to check for the latest release automatically in the background with a direct GitHub icon link.

releases.title: Team Performance Bar Charts, Clean Sub-Tab Workspace, League-Agnostic Rules & Delete Protection
highlights: New Team Performance & Consistency Section (Tab 2A): Displays a bar chart of total team scores per week across the season to identify the most consistent teams.
Reorganized all 5 primary tabs into clean, focused Sub-Tabs so score entry, recap grids, rosters, league rules, charts, side pots, prize funds, and backups never clutter a single page.

League-Agnostic Customization (BLS 2026 Parity): Configurable Bowlers Per Team (1-5), Absentee Rules (Fixed vs. Avg Minus Penalty Pins vs. % of Avg), Max Handicap Cap, Custom Match Points, Mystery Score & High-Game Side Pots, and End-of-Season Prize Fund Calculator.
Added Mandatory 'Are You Sure?' Confirmation Modal before deleting any league, roster bowler, or archived week.

changes.description: Team Performance Weekly Bar Chart & Consistency Analyzer: Visualizes total team scores per week against season weekly averages with variance (± pins), high/low spread, and CSV export.
Dedicated Sub-Tab Bars inside all 5 main tabs (1A-1D, 2A-2D, 3A-3C, 4A-4B, 5A-5C) for easy reading and zero screen clutter.
Added 'Are you sure you want to delete this league?' confirmation popup modal so leagues cannot be accidentally deleted with a single click.
Removed center/league assumptions: customize team size (1-5), absent score calculation formula, handicap caps, custom match point values, and honor roll thresholds.

releases.title: Multi-League Database Manager, Auto-Backup Scheduler & Single-File HTML Fix
highlights: Added Multi-League Database Manager to run and switch between unlimited leagues inside one program.
Added Automatic Backup Scheduler & 1-click Universal Import from a single .json or .html file.

changes.description: Multi-League Switcher & Master Bowler Database metrics (active/inactive bowlers, cross-league duplicates, and backup status).
Fixed standalone .html export escaping so pre-compiled single-file desktop builds open cleanly in any browser.

releases.title: Unified Score Entry, Treasurer Ledger & Multi-Tab Foundation
highlights: Combined the clean rapid keyboard entry of Version 1 with the live standings and 30-step Undo Stack (Ctrl+Z) of Version 2.
Added Treasurer Dues, Lineage & Prize Fund Ledger and Round-Robin Lane Schedule Generator.

changes.description: Fast Enter-key score entry workflow with automatic roster lookup and team completion.
Single-File HTML Self-Updater and backwards-compatible migration from legacy storage keys.

releases.title: Thursday Night Rollers Live Leaderboard Edition
highlights: Added Top 10 Live Bar Chart leaderboard and responsive mobile layout.
Added Season History archiving and previous week reloading.

changes.description: Added visual bar chart for current week high scores.
Added Substitute player checkbox so subs do not clutter the master roster.
